appDescription: A long-distance EV charging assistant that tells the driver where to charge on the route, up to what battery level, and for how long.

function.name: GET_CHARGING_PLAN
function.description: Tells the next recommended EV charging stop on the current trip, the target battery level, and the expected charging time.

function.name: GET_CHARGING_STATUS
function.description: Tells the current EV battery level and, while charging, the time left to the target, the charger time limit, and the departure time.

function.name: ACCEPT_CHARGING_STOP
function.description: Accepts the charging stop that Chargis just recommended and adds it to the navigation as a waypoint.
